content.json:
## Job health
Last 14 days, independent of the time range. **Overdue** means no run within the job's expected interval: 2h hourly feed, 26h daily jobs, 8d weekly library import (deployed schedules in `amf-infrastructure.yml`).

content.query:
let jobs = datatable(Job: string, Span: string, ExpectedEvery: timespan) [
    "Hourly feed", "Tv.Subscriptions.ProcessFeed", 2h,
    "Library import", "Tv.Library.Import", 8d,
    "Automated binding", "Tv.FeedManager.AutomatedBinding", 26h,
    "Feed settlement", "Tv.FeedManager.SettleFeeds", 26h
];
let runs = dependencies
    | where timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where type == "InProc" and name in ((jobs | project Span))
    | summarize LastRun = max(timestamp), LastSuccess = maxif(timestamp, success == true),
        Runs = count(), Failures = countif(success == false) by Span = name;
jobs
| join kind=leftouter runs on Span
| extend Status = case(
    isnull(LastRun) or now() - LastRun > ExpectedEvery, "🔴 Overdue",
    isnull(LastSuccess) or LastSuccess < LastRun, "🟠 Last run failed",
    "🟢 OK")
| project Job, Status, LastRun, LastSuccess, Runs = coalesce(Runs, 0), Failures = coalesce(Failures, 0), ExpectedEvery
content.title: Scheduled jobs
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.json: Failures grouped by **feature**: the span-name prefix (`Tv.Library.Import` → `Tv.Library`). `Warning` and validation failures never mark a span, so they are not counted here.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where type == "InProc" and success == false
| extend Feature = extract(@"^(.+)\.[^.]+$", 1, name)
| where isnotempty(Feature)
| summarize Failures = count() by Feature, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Failed domain spans over time
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where type == "InProc" and success == false
| extend Feature = extract(@"^(.+)\.[^.]+$", 1, name), ErrorType = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"])
| where isnotempty(Feature)
| summarize Failures = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp), SampleOperation = take_any(operation_Id) by Feature, Span = name, ErrorType
| order by Failures desc
content.title: Failed domain spans by feature and error type
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
let spans = dependencies
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where type == "InProc"
    | extend Feature = extract(@"^(.+)\.[^.]+$", 1, name)
    | where isnotempty(Feature)
    | project SpanId = id, Feature;
union
    (traces
        | where timestamp {TimeRange}
        | where severityLevel >= 3
        | project timestamp, operation_Id, operation_ParentId, severityLevel, Kind = "log",
            Source = tostring(customDimensions["CategoryName"]), Message = message),
    (exceptions
        | where timestamp {TimeRange}
        | project timestamp, operation_Id, operation_ParentId, severityLevel, Kind = "exception",
            Source = type, Message = outerMessage)
| join kind=leftouter spans on $left.operation_ParentId == $right.SpanId
| extend Feature = iff(isempty(Feature), "(outside a domain span)", Feature),
    Severity = case(severityLevel == 4, "Critical", severityLevel == 3, "Error", severityLevel == 2, "Warning", "Information")
| summarize Count = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp), SampleMessage = take_any(Message), SampleOperation = take_any(operation_Id)
    by Feature, Kind, Severity, Source
| order by Count desc
content.title: Error logs and exceptions by feature
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.json:
## Web request failures
Failed requests on the web app, by route. Error-page re-executions (`/status-code/{n}`) are reported under their original path; App Service probes are excluded.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "amf-web-manager" and success == false
| extend Path = tostring(parse_url(url).Path)
| where Path !in ("/robots933456.txt", "/robots.txt")
| extend Route = iff(name has "/status-code/", strcat(tostring(split(name, " ")[0]), " ", Path), name)
| summarize Count = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp), SampleOperation = take_any(operation_Id) by Route, Status = resultCode
| order by Count desc
content.title: Failed web requests by route and status
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.json:
## Nyaa jobs
Automated binding and feed settlement run daily. Each backfill shows what requested it: a bind, an hourly poll-window gap, or an admin action.

content.title: Automated binding and feed settlement runs
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
let backfills = dependencies
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where type == "InProc" and name == "Tv.FeedManager.BackfillSeries"
    | project timestamp, SpanId = id, BackfillOperation = operation_Id, Duration = duration, Succeeded = success,
        ErrorType = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"]);
let facts = traces
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where isnotempty(customDimensions["nyaa.catalogued_count"]) and isnotempty(customDimensions["series.title"])
    | summarize Series = take_any(tostring(customDimensions["series.title"])),
        Catalogued = max(toint(customDimensions["nyaa.catalogued_count"])) by SpanId = operation_ParentId;
let producers = requests
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where name == "process backfill-nyaa-series"
    | mv-expand link = todynamic(tostring(customDimensions["_MS.links"]))
    | project BackfillOperation = operation_Id, ProducerOperation = tostring(link.operation_Id);
let roots = dependencies
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where type == "InProc" and name in ("Tv.FeedManager.BindSeries", "Tv.Subscriptions.ProcessFeed", "Admin.BackfillNyaaSeries")
    | summarize RequestedBy = take_any(name) by ProducerOperation = operation_Id;
backfills
| join kind=leftouter facts on SpanId
| join kind=leftouter producers on BackfillOperation
| join kind=leftouter roots on ProducerOperation
| project timestamp, Series, Catalogued, Duration, Succeeded, ErrorType,
    RequestedBy = case(RequestedBy == "Tv.FeedManager.BindSeries", "bind", RequestedBy == "Tv.Subscriptions.ProcessFeed", "hourly gap",
        RequestedBy == "Admin.BackfillNyaaSeries", "admin", "unknown"),
    BackfillOperation
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Backfills
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.json:
## Library refresh
`Tv.Library.Import` per season. Downstream counts follow one hop of linked messages.

content.query:
let runs = dependencies
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where name == "Tv.Library.Import"
    | project RunStart = timestamp, RunOperation = operation_Id, Duration = duration, Succeeded = success,
        ErrorType = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"]);
let manual = requests
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where name == "process update-tv-series"
    | distinct RunOperation = operation_Id
    | extend Manual = true;
let facts = traces
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where operation_Id in ((runs | project RunOperation))
    | summarize
        Season = take_anyif(tostring(customDimensions["series.season"]), isnotempty(customDimensions["series.season"])),
        New = max(toint(customDimensions["series.new_count"])),
        Updated = max(toint(customDimensions["series.updated_count"])),
        ImagesDownloaded = max(toint(customDimensions["image.downloaded_count"])),
        ImagesFailed = max(toint(customDimensions["image.failed_count"])),
        PagesExpected = max(toint(customDimensions["scrape.pages_expected"])),
        PagesFetched = max(toint(customDimensions["scrape.pages_fetched"]))
        by RunOperation = operation_Id;
let downstream = requests
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where name startswith "process "
    | mv-expand link = todynamic(tostring(customDimensions["_MS.links"]))
    | summarize Downstream = dcount(operation_Id) by RunOperation = tostring(link.operation_Id);
runs
| join kind=leftouter manual on RunOperation
| join kind=leftouter facts on RunOperation
| join kind=leftouter downstream on RunOperation
| project RunStart, Trigger = iff(Manual == true, "manual", "timer"), Season, Duration, Succeeded, ErrorType,
    New, Updated, ImagesDownloaded, ImagesFailed, PagesExpected, PagesFetched,
    Downstream = coalesce(Downstream, 0), RunOperation
| order by RunStart desc
content.title: Library refresh runs (select a run for its downstream messages)

content.json:
## AnimeSchedule
A `429` bans the caller's whole IP range for days: any non-zero **RateLimited** needs attention.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where type =~ "HTTP" and target has "animeschedule.net"
| summarize Calls = count(), RateLimited = countif(resultCode == "429"), ServerErrors = countif(resultCode startswith "5"),
    Failed = countif(success == false), P50 = percentile(duration, 50), P95 = percentile(duration, 95) by Host = target
content.title: Calls by host
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where type =~ "HTTP" and target has "animeschedule.net"
| summarize Calls = count() by Status = strcat(target, " ", resultCode), bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Calls by status over time

content.json:
## Scrape completeness
One row per AnimeSchedule fetch: pages the provider reported vs pages actually read.

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(customDimensions["scrape.query"]) and isnotempty(customDimensions["scrape.entry_count"])
| project timestamp, Query = tostring(customDimensions["scrape.query"]), Entries = toint(customDimensions["scrape.entry_count"]),
    PagesExpected = toint(customDimensions["scrape.pages_expected"]), PagesFetched = toint(customDimensions["scrape.pages_fetched"]),
    PagesFailed = coalesce(toint(customDimensions["scrape.pages_failed"]), 0), Operation = operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: AnimeSchedule fetches
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.json:
## Nyaa
Calls by the job that made them. A `429` fails the call, not necessarily the job: the HTTP retry may recover it, so check the backfill's outcome in **Flows**.

content.query:
let jobs = dependencies
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where type == "InProc" and name startswith "Tv."
    | summarize Job = take_any(name) by operation_Id;
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where type =~ "HTTP" and target == "nyaa.si"
| join kind=leftouter jobs on operation_Id
| summarize Calls = count(), RateLimited = countif(resultCode == "429"), ServerErrors = countif(resultCode startswith "5"),
    Failed = countif(success == false), P50 = percentile(duration, 50), P95 = percentile(duration, 95)
    by Job = iff(isempty(Job), "(no domain span)", Job), Role = cloud_RoleName
| order by Failed desc, Calls desc
content.title: Calls by job
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
let jobs = dependencies
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}

| where type =~ "HTTP" and target == "nyaa.si" and success == false
| join kind=leftouter jobs on operation_Id
| project timestamp, Job = iff(isempty(Job), "(no domain span)", Job), Status = resultCode, Duration = duration, Role = cloud_RoleName,
    Operation = operation_Id

content.json: Send and process spans join on `messaging.message.id`. Latency is first processing minus send, so it includes the Functions queue-polling delay.

content.query:
let sends = dependencies
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where name startswith "send " and success == true
    | project SentAt = timestamp, MessageId = tostring(customDimensions["messaging.message.id"]), Queue = substring(name, 5);
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name startswith "process "
| extend MessageId = trim('"', tostring(customDimensions["messaging.message.id"]))
| summarize ProcessedAt = min(timestamp) by MessageId
| join kind=inner sends on MessageId
| extend LatencySeconds = (ProcessedAt - SentAt) / 1s
| summarize Messages = count(), P50 = percentile(LatencySeconds, 50), P95 = percentile(LatencySeconds, 95),
    Max = max(LatencySeconds) by Queue
| order by P95 desc
content.title: Queue latency by queue (seconds)
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name startswith "send "
| summarize Sends = count(), Failed = countif(success == false), LastFailure = maxif(timestamp, success == false),
    ErrorTypes = make_set_if(tostring(customDimensions["error.type"]), success == false),
    Roles = make_set(cloud_RoleName) by Queue = substring(name, 5)
| extend FailureRate = round(100.0 * Failed / Sends, 2)
| order by Failed desc, Sends desc
content.title: Sends by queue
